analysis_walkthrough.business_objective_summary: Modernize a legacy VB6 banking application into C#, ensuring current functionality is preserved, documented, and validated, with deployment for Docker testing.
requirements_understanding: The legacy application is a VB6 banking system with multiple forms and ActiveX dependencies.
Modernization involves rewriting the application in C# while maintaining existing business logic and UI behavior.
The project requires documenting current functionality, designing a new architecture, implementing services, and running QA/security checks.
conversion_to_technical_requirements: Rewriting VB6 forms and logic into C# classes and methods.
Replacing ActiveX dependencies with .NET equivalents or alternatives.
Implementing a Docker-based deployment pipeline for testing.
clarifications_requested: Are there any specific new features or enhancements required beyond modernization?
What is the expected timeline for the modernization project?

output.executive_summary: This project aims to modernize a legacy VB6 banking application into C#, ensuring functional parity and backward compatibility, with deployment in Docker for testing.

functional_requirements.title: Rewrite Login Form
functional_requirements.description: The login form must be rewritten in C# to authenticate users against the existing database.
acceptance_criteria: The login form must display correctly in the C# application.
The form must authenticate users using the existing database schema.
Error messages must be displayed for invalid credentials.

functional_requirements.title: Implement Customer Management
functional_requirements.description: Customer management functionality must be rewritten in C# to allow CRUD operations on customer data.
acceptance_criteria: The customer management interface must allow adding, editing, and deleting customer records.
Changes must be persisted to the existing database.
The interface must display confirmation messages for successful operations.

functional_requirements.title: Recreate Deposit and Withdrawal Forms
functional_requirements.description: Deposit and withdrawal forms must be rewritten in C# to handle transactions.
acceptance_criteria: The forms must allow users to input transaction details and submit them.
Transactions must update the database correctly.
The forms must validate input data before submission.

functional_requirements.title: Transaction Processing Service
functional_requirements.description: Implement a C# service to process banking transactions.
acceptance_criteria: The service must process transactions and update account balances.
It must handle concurrency and ensure data integrity.
The service must log transaction details for auditing.

functional_requirements.title: Data Refresh Functionality
functional_requirements.description: Implement functionality to refresh data displayed on forms in C#.
acceptance_criteria: The refresh button must reload the data from the database.
The UI must reflect the latest data without requiring a restart.
The refresh operation must complete within 2 seconds.

functional_requirements.title: Security Checks Implementation
functional_requirements.description: Implement security checks in the C# application to prevent unauthorized access.
acceptance_criteria: The application must enforce role-based access control.
Sensitive data must be encrypted in transit and at rest.
Security logs must be maintained for all access attempts.

functional_requirements.title: Docker Deployment Setup
functional_requirements.description: Set up Docker deployment for the C# application for local testing.
acceptance_criteria: The application must run in a Docker container on a local machine.
Docker setup must include all necessary dependencies.
The deployment process must be documented and reproducible.

functional_requirements.title: Documentation of Current Functionality
functional_requirements.description: Document all current functionalities and their acceptance criteria for the legacy system.
acceptance_criteria: All forms and their functionalities must be documented.
Acceptance criteria for each functionality must be clearly defined.
Documentation must be reviewed and approved by stakeholders.

non_functional_requirements.title: Performance Requirements
non_functional_requirements.description: The C# application must perform efficiently under expected load conditions.
non_functional_requirements.metric: Response time must be under 2 seconds for all operations.
acceptance_criteria: All operations must complete within 2 seconds under normal load.
The application must handle at least 100 concurrent users.
Performance must be tested and verified using load testing tools.

non_functional_requirements.title: Security Requirements
non_functional_requirements.description: Ensure the application meets security standards to protect sensitive data.
non_functional_requirements.metric: Must pass all OWASP Top 10 security checks.
acceptance_criteria: The application must not have any critical vulnerabilities.
Regular security audits must be conducted.
All data must be encrypted using industry-standard algorithms.

non_functional_requirements.title: Scalability Requirements
non_functional_requirements.description: The application must be scalable to accommodate future growth.
non_functional_requirements.metric: Must support scaling up to 1000 concurrent users.
acceptance_criteria: The application architecture must support horizontal scaling.
Load balancing must be implemented to distribute traffic.
Scalability must be tested and documented.

non_functional_requirements.title: Reliability Requirements
non_functional_requirements.description: The application must be reliable and have minimal downtime.
acceptance_criteria: The application must have automated failover mechanisms.
Downtime must not exceed 0.1% annually.
Regular backups must be scheduled and verified.

non_functional_requirements.title: Usability Requirements
non_functional_requirements.description: The application must be user-friendly and intuitive.
non_functional_requirements.metric: User satisfaction score must be above 85%.
acceptance_criteria: The application must pass usability testing with a score above 85%.
User feedback must be collected and analyzed regularly.
The UI must adhere to modern design standards.
